items.label: Shenzhen Fastprint Circuit Tech annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-25-2026)
items.signal_prefix: Company (annual report): the FCBGA substrate project is prepared for volume production

set.signal: Company (annual report): the FCBGA substrate project is prepared for volume production in technology, capacity and yield; sample orders rose sharply YoY with a rising share of high-layer, large-size products. Its built capacity is ramping, but orders are growing slowly because of long customer certification cycles, so utilization is low and unit labor, depreciation and energy costs are high; in 2026 the company will push domestic customers and pursue overseas customers' factory audits, sampling and volume production. Construction in progress: Guangzhou FCBGA substrate project (budget RMB 5,000,000,000.00) 63.41% complete; Zhuhai FCBGA substrate project (budget RMB 1,000,000,000.00) 91.72%, transferred to fixed assets in 2025, taking with it a construction-in-progress impairment of RMB 5,266,570.01 already held at the start of the year (reason given: volume-production progress and investment returns fell short of expectations); Zhuhai Xingke IC package substrate project (budget RMB 1,600,000,000.00) 90.03%.

items.reason: The RMB 5,266,570.01 impairment is the OPENING balance of the Zhuhai FCBGA CIP impairment (provided before 2025) and was reduced in 2025 when the project was transferred to fixed assets; the entry read as if the impairment was booked in 2025.
